SlideMate 0.6 sets itself up in three steps: sign in to your AI, find your university, sign in to it. Then your
slides appear in the sidebar.

### New
- **A welcome screen instead of Settings.** Pick ChatGPT (free account) or a paid Claude, Gemini, Cursor or Grok
  plan. SlideMate installs it if needed and opens your browser to sign in, with no Terminal window. (Claude shows a
  code in the browser: paste it into SlideMate.)
- **Find your university by name or email.** Type "LSE", "Oxford" or `you@uni.ac.uk`: SlideMate finds its Canvas,
  Moodle or Blackboard, checks it, and connects it. Settings → Your university uses the same list of 60+
  universities.
- **No folder to choose.** Slides go into SlideMate's own folder (Settings → Library → Show in Finder). Folders you
  already use can still be added there.
- **Slides arrive live.** During a Pull, each new file slides into the sidebar as it downloads, and is sorted into
  Lectures, Labs and Readings a moment later.
- **Only what you study.** Pulls skip sites that aren't courses (guidance hubs, LSE Life, library skills,
  noticeboards) and posters, handbooks, forms and timetables. The sidebar lists what was left out, with **Add** to
  bring a site in. Your Moodle or Blackboard connection updates itself to do this.
- **Move to Applications.** Opened SlideMate from Downloads? It offers to move itself, so it can keep itself up to date.
- **First-launch help beside the app.** ZIP and DMG downloads include an offline **Start Here.html** guide to installing SlideMate and approving it in macOS Privacy & Security if prompted.
- Settings → AI tutor signs in the same way, without Terminal.
